page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core. This hardware profile is designed for compute-heavy workloads that require high CPU density relative to memory capacity.

The instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers across the cloud environment. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance. The lack of local storage and GPUs represents a clear tradeoff, focusing resources entirely on raw CPU execution and network throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c7.32xlarge offers a high density of dedicated compute resources, making it a viable option for parallel processing tasks where memory footprint is secondary to CPU core count. Appropriate workloads for this instance type include high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, video encoding, and large-scale web serving or application hosting that demands intensive computational power.
